speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; to begin my evaluation, how many weeks pregnant are you and when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The patient's history of consuming unpasteurized dairy (ice cream) shortly before symptom onset, combined with flu-like symptoms at 30 weeks gestation, is classic for this diagnosis. I am ready to proceed with confirmation tests if needed.
